svg.title: A vertical cut across the line near a building
svg.desc: A double-circuit line in a vertical plane across it, a house beside it: the field computed at every point of a grid in the plane, its isolines of 3, 10 and 30 microtesla drawn between the points and cut at the ground.
svg.text: A vertical cut across the line: what reaches a building
Drawn here with infinite conductors (2D, to scale); the program computes the cut from the solved 3D wires.
